lead.headline: Securitize NYSE Debut Signals Mainstream Tokenization Pivot
lead.tldr: The convergence of traditional equity listings and blockchain issuance marks a shift from experimental RWA pilots to integrated capital market infrastructure.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: Securitize Debuts on NYSE, Issues Tokenized Stocks
top_signals.summary: Securitize has officially debuted on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE). To mark the occasion, the company issued tokenized versions of its own shares on the Solana and Avalanche blockchains.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Securitize's dual-track listing on the NYSE and Solana/Avalanche validates the hybrid model of traditional compliance and on-chain liquidity.

top_signals.title: ESMA Says Many Prediction Market Contracts Fall Under Existing EU Rules
top_signals.summary: The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has warned that many prediction market event contracts may already be prohibited for EU retail investors. The agency suggests that existing securities rules may apply, potentially limiting the legality of these markets without the need for new legislation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: ESMA's stance on prediction markets suggests a restrictive regulatory environment for retail event contracts in the EU, limiting the addressable market for these platforms.

top_signals.title: Crypto Biz: Strategy’s Bitcoin Shift, Open USD Launch, Fidelity Weighs In
top_signals.summary: A roundup of major crypto developments including MicroStrategy's authorization of up to $1.25 billion in Bitcoin sales and the launch of Open USD. Additionally, Fidelity reaffirmed its support for Bitcoin's long-term security amidst rising political spending in the crypto sector.
top_signals.why_it_matters: MicroStrategy's $1.25 billion Bitcoin sale authorization indicates a potential shift in treasury management strategy or a move to lock in gains.

top_signals.title: EU crypto rulebook faces enforcement challenge as MiCA transition endsLawyers and industry executives expect EU regulators to enforce MiCA differently as unauthorized crypto companies are required to wind down operations.
top_signals.summary: The European Union is entering the enforcement phase of the Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation as the transition period ends. Legal experts and industry leaders anticipate inconsistent enforcement as unauthorized crypto firms are pressured to wind down operations.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The transition to MiCA enforcement creates a period of operational risk for firms that failed to secure authorization in time.

top_signals.title: StanChart joins ESMA's first MiCA register update since deadline17m, StanChart joins ESMA's first MiCA register update since deadlineESMA publishes its first post-deadline MiCA register update, adding 37 crypto-asset service providers, including Standard Chartered and FalconX.
top_signals.summary: The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has released its first post-deadline MiCA register update. The update includes 37 crypto-asset service providers, notably featuring major financial institutions like Standard Chartered and FalconX.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The inclusion of Standard Chartered and FalconX in the MiCA register confirms that top-tier financial institutions are prioritizing EU regulatory alignment.

on_the_radar.title: RBI Backs Crypto Containment as India Prepares Policy Report
on_the_radar.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is advocating for the containment of cryptocurrencies, specifically proposing limits on bank exposure and payment processing. This comes as Indian lawmakers work toward finalizing policy recommendations for digital assets.

on_the_radar.title: Donald Trump Says ‘Nothing Wrong’ with $1.4B Crypto Windfall While in Office
on_the_radar.summary: Donald Trump defended his $1.4 billion in crypto-related income during a CNBC appearance, asserting that the windfall was legal. The comments follow the release of his 2025 financial disclosures.

on_the_radar.title: IMF says policy choices will determine whether tokenization strengthens or fragments the financial system
on_the_radar.summary: The IMF warns that the impact of tokenization on the financial system depends heavily on policy choices. Tobias Adrian noted that risks may shift from traditional banks toward smart contracts and market infrastructure providers as adoption grows.

on_the_radar.title: A $75 billion valuation, 75 million global customers and on its way to America—Revolut is London’s disruptor extraordinaire
on_the_radar.summary: Revolut has reached a valuation of $75 billion in its latest fundraising round as it prepares for a potential US market entry and a future IPO. The fintech giant is backed by major investors including Nvidia and SoftBank.

on_the_radar.title: Bank of Russia governor says 'everything is ready' for widespread use of digital ruble ahead of September rollout
on_the_radar.summary: The Bank of Russia has announced that it is prepared for the widespread rollout of the digital ruble starting in September. The central bank is also exploring the use of stablecoins to complement the digital ruble for international transactions.

on_the_radar.title: US spot Bitcoin ETFs top $200M in daily inflows for first time since May30m, US spot Bitcoin ETFs top $200M in daily inflows for first time since MayUS spot Bitcoin ETFs post $221.7 million inflows, the strongest daily intake since early May, as Bitcoin recovers above $61,000.
on_the_radar.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded daily inflows of $221.7 million, marking the strongest daily intake since early May. This surge coincides with Bitcoin's price recovery above the $61,000 threshold.

on_the_radar.title: CryptoQuant says bitcoin and altcoin exchange deposits have spiked, indicating higher volatility ahead
on_the_radar.summary: CryptoQuant reports a significant spike in Bitcoin and altcoin deposits to exchanges, reaching nearly 49,000 BTC. This trend is viewed as a signal of potential high volatility and increased selling pressure.

on_the_radar.title: Spotify asks Kalshi, Polymarket to remove branding after manipulated streams used to settle music bets: Bloomberg
on_the_radar.summary: Spotify has requested that prediction markets Kalshi and Polymarket remove its branding following the manipulation of music streaming data. Approximately 500,000 fake streams were used to rig a $3 million betting market.

worth_a_read.title: Weekly Top Stories: Strategy's new strategy
worth_a_read.note: Provides a critical analysis of MicroStrategy's evolving Bitcoin treasury strategy and its implications for market volatility.

linkedin_post: Securitize debuting on the NYSE while simultaneously issuing tokenized shares on Solana and Avalanche is the most concrete signal we've seen regarding the future of equity. I keep coming back to the fact that this isn't a pilot or a sandbox test; it is a live integration of a public listing with multi-chain issuance. When you see a firm move from 'exploring' tokenization to actually listing on the NYSE and using Avalanche and Solana for distribution, the friction between traditional finance and Web3 infrastructure drops significantly. I'd watch how other mid-cap firms approach their IPOs now that a blueprint for hybrid issuance exists. The real question is whether the liquidity benefits of on-chain shares will eventually outweigh the prestige of a centralized exchange listing.
